title: Gastro tražilica - Videos
description:
First Balkan food review channel. We seek out the flavours and good food in Croatia and Balkan countries. 

Ultimate Balkan Food Guide or Gastro tražilica is the first YouTube channel that promote famous and lesser-known restaurants on Balkan, or gastronomic destinations in the former ex-Yugoslav countries.

If you are a gourmet, a true food lover or just love to eat well then you are at the right place!

Produkcija i ideja j.d.o.o. 2019. ALL RIGHTS RESERVED.
